sheets.name: Pattern Wise Sheet
sheets.description: Master data structures and algorithms topic by topic

topics.name: Array
topics.description: Fundamental collection of elements stored at contiguous memory locations.

subtopics.name: Two-Pointer
subtopics.strategy: Use two indices that move towards or away from each other to reduce redundant comparisons.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves pairs, sorted arrays, triplets, or opposite-end traversal.

subtopics.name: Sliding Window
subtopics.strategy: Maintain a window of fixed size or expand/shrink it to satisfy a condition.
subtopics.identification: Problem uses words like “window of size k”, “longest”, “shortest”, or “at most K”.

problems.title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K

subtopics.name: Prefix Sum
subtopics.strategy: Precompute cumulative sums so any subarray or range sum can be answered in O(1).
subtopics.identification: Problem talks about range sum, subarray sum, cumulative sum, or prefix-based queries.

problems.title: Matrix Block Sum (Running Sum of 2D Array)

subtopics.name: Kadane’s Algorithm
subtopics.strategy: Track the best subarray sum ending at each index and update the global maximum.
subtopics.identification: Problem asks for maximum/minimum sum or product of a contiguous subarray.

problems.title: Maximum Absolute Sum of Any Subarray

topics.name: Strings
topics.description: Sequence of characters and common string manipulation patterns.

subtopics.name: Two-Pointer (Palindrome)
subtopics.strategy: Compare characters from both ends and move inward until the condition fails.
subtopics.identification: Problem talks about palindrome checks, symmetric comparison, or reversing from both ends.

subtopics.name: Sliding Window (String)
subtopics.strategy: Maintain a moving window and adjust its size to satisfy character constraints.
subtopics.identification: Problem uses words like longest, shortest, substring, at most K, exactly K.

problems.title: Find All Anagrams in a String
Substring with Concatenation of All Words

topics.name: Binary Search
topics.description: Efficient search algorithm that divides the search interval in half.

subtopics.name: Classic Binary Search
subtopics.strategy: Divide-and-conquer → narrow search space in sorted array.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions a sorted array or “find element efficiently.”

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

subtopics.name: Lower / Upper Bound
subtopics.strategy: Find first/last occurrence or smallest/largest index satisfying a condition.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions first/last occurrence, bounds, or constraints on index.

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element

subtopics.name: Binary Search on Answers
subtopics.strategy: Treat answer space as sorted → binary search to find minimum/maximum feasible value.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions minimum/maximum feasible value or optimization over a range.

problems.title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
Min Speed to Arrive on Time
Min number of days to make m bouquets

subtopics.name: Search in 2D Matrix
subtopics.strategy: Apply binary search row-wise / column-wise or flattened array.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions 2D matrix, row/column sorted, or kth smallest element.

problems.title: Kth Smallest Element in Sorted Matrix

topics.name: Stack
topics.description: LIFO (Last In First Out) data structure patterns.

subtopics.name: Monotonic Stack
subtopics.strategy: Maintain a monotonic increasing/decreasing stack to find next/prev greater/smaller, histogram ranges, or collisions.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “next greater/smaller element,” spans, or trapping area.

subtopics.name: Expression Evaluation
subtopics.strategy: Use two stacks or postfix evaluation to handle numbers and operators efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves evaluating arithmetic expressions, parentheses, or decoding strings.

subtopics.name: Stack Simulation / Undo Operation
subtopics.strategy: Simulate operations using a stack → pop on undo, remove adjacent duplicates, collapse characters.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “undo,” “remove duplicates,” or “backspace string” operations.

problems.title: Minimum String Length After Removing Substrings

subtopics.name: Parenthesis & Scoring
subtopics.strategy: Push opening symbols and validate closing ones; sometimes track count or score.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions parentheses, balanced brackets, scoring, or generation.

problems.title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid

subtopics.name: Stack-Based Design
subtopics.strategy: Use two stacks to implement another data structure or maintain extra info.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions designing stack/queue systems or custom operations.

subtopics.name: Stack + Greedy
subtopics.strategy: Combine stack properties with greedy choices to optimize strings or numbers.
subtopics.identification: Problems asking for smallest/largest sequence, removing k elements

problems.title: Minimum Remove to Make Valid Parentheses

subtopics.name: Recursive Stack
subtopics.strategy: Handle top/head element recursively → recurse on remaining stack/list → combine/insert results.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions reverse/insert/delete recursively, sort stack, merge lists, or check palindrome recursively.

topics.name: Recursion
topics.description: Solving problems by breaking them down into smaller, self-similar subproblems.

subtopics.name: Linear Recursion
subtopics.strategy: Solve problems by reducing them to a simpler instance of the same problem.
subtopics.identification: Problems requiring repetitive smaller tasks without splitting into multiple branches.

subtopics.name: Non-Linear Recursion
subtopics.strategy: Make multiple recursive calls at each step to explore different branches and combine their results.
subtopics.identification: Problems where each step leads to multiple possibilities, such as Fibonacci sequences or finding unique paths on a grid.

subtopics.name: Divide & Conquer
subtopics.strategy: Divide the problem into smaller subproblems, solve them recursively, and combine results.
subtopics.identification: Sorting, searching in structured data, reducing complexity logarithmically.

subtopics.name: Recursion on LinkedList/Stack
subtopics.strategy: Process data structures recursively by handling the first/last element and recursing on the rest.
subtopics.identification: Problems asking to reverse, delete, or merge standard linear data structures.

subtopics.name: Subsequences
subtopics.strategy: Explore all possible subsets by choosing to include or exclude each element.
subtopics.identification: Problems asking for subsets, combinations, or subsequences.

topics.name: Linked List
topics.description: Linear data structure where elements are not stored at contiguous memory locations.

subtopics.name: Basic Operations
subtopics.strategy: Directly manipulate pointers to insert, delete, traverse, and get length.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions insertion, deletion at head/tail/Nth node or traversal.

problems.title: Insert at Head / Tail / Nth Position

subtopics.name: Fast and Slow Pointers
subtopics.strategy: Use two pointers at different speeds to detect cycles, middle node, or duplicates.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves loops, cycle detection, or middle node operations.

subtopics.name: Reversal Pattern
subtopics.strategy: Reverse entire list, partial list, or groups to reorder nodes.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions reversing nodes or rearranging linked list order.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List II (between m & n)
Maximum Twin Sum of a Linked List

subtopics.name: Merge / Sort
subtopics.strategy: Merge sorted lists, sort list using merge sort, or reorder using middle + reverse + merge.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions merging, sorting, or reordering linked lists.

problems.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List II

subtopics.name: LinkedList with Stack/HashMap
subtopics.strategy: Use a stack to handle backward traversal, carry logic, or next greater node.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions reverse order processing or “next greater” style operations.

problems.title: Next Greater Node in Linked List

topics.name: Double Linked List
topics.description: Linked List with navigation in both forward and backward directions.

subtopics.name: Basic DLL Operations
subtopics.strategy: Maintain prev and next pointers carefully for insert, delete, traversal; use DLL + HashMap for O(1) cache operations.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions insertion/deletion in DLL, printing forwards/backwards, or caching (LRU/MRU/frequency-based).

problems.title: Insert a node in a doubly Linkedlist
Delete a node from a doubly Linkedlist

subtopics.name: Merge / Sort / Reorder
subtopics.strategy: Use DLL properties (prev/next) to efficiently merge, sort, reorder, flatten, or perform pointer-based checks.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves multi-level DLL, sorting, alternating nodes, palindrome check, conversions, or pair sums.

topics.name: HashMap
topics.description: Key-value pair data structure for O(1) average time complexity lookups.

subtopics.name: Frequency Map / Counting
subtopics.strategy: Count elements to find majority, top-k frequent, or sort by frequency.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions frequency, duplicates, top-k, or counting occurrences.

subtopics.name: Prefix-Sum with Map
subtopics.strategy: Track cumulative sums; map stores first occurrence → solve subarray sum problems.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves subarray sums, cumulative sums, or “sum equals K”.

topics.name: Binary Tree
topics.description: Hierarchical data structure with a root value and subtrees of children.

subtopics.name: DFS Traversals
subtopics.strategy: Standard DFS → used for max depth, path sums, subtree calculations.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “visit all nodes recursively, max depth/path/subtree sum.”

problems.title: Print All Nodes at Distance K
Boundary Traversal of a Binary Tree

subtopics.name: BFS / Level-Order
subtopics.strategy: Use queue → traverse level by level → calculate sums, averages, or side views.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “level-order, breadth-first, zigzag, right-side view, or level sum/average.”

problems.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
Average of Levels in Binary Tree
Populating Next Right Pointers in Each Node
Top View of a Binary Tree

subtopics.name: Lowest Common Ancestor
subtopics.strategy: DFS recursion or parent-pointer mapping → find common ancestor efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “find common ancestor, distance between nodes, or lowest node covering two nodes.”

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of Binary Tree
Lowest Common Ancestor of Deepest Leaves

subtopics.name: Serialization / Construction
subtopics.strategy: Preorder / level-order encode-decode → reconstruct tree or flatten.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “serialize tree, flatten tree to list, next pointers, or reconstruct tree.”

problems.title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
Construct Binary Tree from Preorder & Inorder
Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder Traversal
Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Postorder Traversal

subtopics.name: BST
subtopics.strategy: Leverage BST property (left < root < right) for search, insertion, deletion, and range queries.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “BST operations, validate BST, insert/delete nodes, or sum/range queries.”

problems.title: Two Sum IV: Input is a BST
Maximum sum BST in binary Tree
Convert Binary Tree to Doubly Linked List
Construct Binary Search Tree from Preorder Traversal

topics.name: Graph
topics.description: Non-linear data structure consisting of nodes and edges.

subtopics.name: BFS (Unweighted Path)
subtopics.strategy: Standard BFS → track distance/levels → queue-based traversal → multi-source if needed.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “shortest path, level-order traversal, or unweighted distance”.

subtopics.name: DFS (Connectivity)
subtopics.strategy: DFS recursion or stack → track visited → identify connected components or detect cycles.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “connected components, islands, cycles, safe states, bipartite check, bridges, articulation points, or connectivity check”.

problems.title: All paths from source to target

subtopics.name: Topological Sort
subtopics.strategy: DFS postorder or BFS (Kahn’s algorithm) → order nodes respecting dependencies.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “ordering tasks, course prerequisites, dependency chains, build order, or cycle in directed graph”.

subtopics.name: MST / Union-Find
subtopics.strategy: Use Kruskal’s / Prim’s algorithm or Union-Find → find MST, minimum cost connections, or detect cycles.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “minimum cost to connect all nodes, redundant connections, union-find required”.

problems.title: Number of Connected Components in Graph

subtopics.name: Dijkstra (Weighted)
subtopics.strategy: Use priority queue → relax edges → track shortest distances.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “weighted edges, shortest path, or minimum distance in weighted graph”.

subtopics.name: Bellman-Ford
subtopics.strategy: Relax all edges V-1 times → detect negative cycles.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “negative weights, cycles, or cost minimization with negative edges”.

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops (Bellman-Ford variant)
Find the City With the Smallest Number of Neighbors at a Threshold Distance

subtopics.name: Floyd-Warshall
subtopics.strategy: DP over adjacency matrix → shortest paths between all pairs of nodes.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “all-pairs shortest paths, matrix, or city connectivity between any two nodes”.

topics.name: Heap
topics.description: Priority Queue data structure for efficient retrieval of highest/lowest priority elements.

subtopics.name: Top-K Elements
subtopics.strategy: Use min-heap for top-k largest, max-heap for top-k smallest → maintain heap of size k.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions top k, kth largest/smallest, median, or maintaining running extremes.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array

subtopics.name: Merge K Sorted
subtopics.strategy: Use min-heap to merge multiple sorted arrays/lists efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions merging sorted arrays/lists or finding K smallest/largest pairs across arrays.

problems.title: Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums
Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists

subtopics.name: Heap with Sliding Window
subtopics.strategy: Maintain a heap of elements in the window → pop outdated elements → track maximum.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions sliding window maximum/minimum or frequency-based window queries.

subtopics.name: Implementation of Heap
subtopics.strategy: Design heap.
subtopics.identification: Design Priority Queue

subtopics.name: Huffman pattern
subtopics.strategy: Repeatedly combine the two smallest elements to minimize the total cost..
subtopics.identification: Repeatedly combine the two smallest elements to minimize the total cost.

problems.title: Combine Cards / Numbers with Minimum Cost

topics.name: Backtracking
topics.description: Algorithmic technique for solving problems recursively by trying to build a solution incrementally.

subtopics.name: Choice-Based Backtracking
subtopics.strategy: It is commonly used in problems that ask to generate all possible combinations, subsets, or permutations.
subtopics.identification: This approach forms a recursion tree and is the backbone of backtracking problems.

subtopics.name: Constraint-Based Backtracking
subtopics.strategy: At each step, choose whether to include an element → explore all subsets/choices recursively.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “generate all subsets, combinations, parentheses, letters from digits, or selection without rearranging order.”

problems.title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets

subtopics.name: Grid / Path Backtracking
subtopics.strategy: Move in grid recursively → explore all valid paths → backtrack after each move.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maze, grid, pathfinding, sudoku, word search in grid, Hamiltonian path, or max path gold.”

subtopics.name: Decision Tree / Sequence Generation
subtopics.strategy: Generate sequences or strings recursively by making a choice at each step.
subtopics.identification: Problems where you recursively build sequences, combinations of digits/letters, or expressions.

problems.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number

topics.name: Greedy
topics.description: Algorithm paradigm that follows the problem solving heuristic of making the locally optimal choice.

subtopics.name: Intervals & Reach
subtopics.strategy: Sort intervals or extend reach as far as possible from current position → maximize tasks done / minimize steps.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maximum non-overlapping intervals, tasks, meetings, jump to end, minimum steps, or cover intervals”.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
Minimum Number of Taps to Open to Water Garden

subtopics.name: Sorting / Local Choice
subtopics.strategy: Sort array or select elements → make locally optimal choice → achieve global optimum.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maximize/minimize sum, select elements optimally, assign/distribute resources, or custom order”.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Optimization method involving breaking down problems into simpler subproblems and storing their solutions.

subtopics.name: 1D / Linear DP
subtopics.strategy: Track optimal solution using a 1D array → sequences, sums, or counts.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “subarrays, sequences, max/min sum/product, or linear decisions”.

subtopics.name: 2D / Grid DP
subtopics.strategy: Use 2D array → track states for row/column → movement or path constraints.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “grids, movement from start to end, paths, or matrix-based sums”.

subtopics.name: DP on Strings
subtopics.strategy: Use 2D DP → index i,j represent substrings/subsequences → solve LCS, palindrome, or edit distance.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “subsequence, substring, longest common, palindrome, or string edit operations”.

problems.title: Minimum Insertions to Make String Palindrome
Minimum Number of Insertions and Deletions

subtopics.name: DP on Intervals
subtopics.strategy: Track optimal solutions for subarrays/intervals → matrix chain, merging, or balloon burst patterns.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “intervals, subarray partitions, merging cost, or burst balloons”.

problems.title: Min cost to cut a stick

subtopics.name: DP on Trees / DAGs
subtopics.strategy: Recursion + memoization → track states along tree paths → post-order traversal.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “trees, DAGs, path sums, node coverage, or ways to traverse dependent nodes”.

subtopics.name: Knapsack / Subset Sum
subtopics.strategy: Track states based on weight/value → classic 0-1 / bounded / unbounded variants.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “choose subset under constraints, maximize value, target sum, or weight limit”.

subtopics.name: DP on Stocks
subtopics.strategy: State machine DP to track whether you are holding a stock or not.
subtopics.identification: Problems involving buying and selling stocks to maximize profit with varying constraints.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee

topics.name: Trie
topics.description: Tree-based data structure used for efficiently storing and retrieving keys in a dataset of strings.

subtopics.name: Basic Trie Operations
subtopics.strategy: Build Trie → insert words → search full word or prefix efficiently → collect suggestions in lexicographic order.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “dictionary, prefix search, word lookup, autocomplete, or predictive text”.

subtopics.name: Word Break / Segmentation
subtopics.strategy: Use Trie for fast lookup → combine with DP or backtracking for word segmentation and concatenation.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “word segmentation, dictionary words, concatenated words, or string break”.

subtopics.name: Bitwise Trie / XOR
subtopics.strategy: Use Trie for binary representation of numbers → efficiently find maximum/minimum XOR or subset XOR.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maximize XOR, XOR queries, bit-level optimization, or subsets”.

problems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in Array
Maximum XOR With an Element From Array

topics.name: Bit Manipulation
topics.description: Techniques that perform operations on data at the bit level.

subtopics.name: Basic Bit Operations
subtopics.strategy: Use XOR / AND / OR / shift operations → detect single/missing numbers or count bits efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “unique element, missing number, or bit counting”.

problems.title: Check kth bit is set or not

subtopics.name: Subsets / Bitmask
subtopics.strategy: Iterate through all subsets using bits → solve combinatorial or DP counting problems.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “generate subsets, combinations, or mask enumeration”.

problems.title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets

subtopics.name: Advanced XOR
subtopics.strategy: Use XOR properties → maximize/minimize XOR over array/subarray or ranges.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maximize XOR, XOR queries, pairs, or range XOR”.

problems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in Array
Maximum XOR With an Element From Array

subtopics.name: Fast and Slow Pointers
subtopics.strategy: Use two pointers at different speeds to detect cycles, middle node, or duplicates.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves loops, cycle detection, or middle node operations.

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List

subtopics.name: Reversal Pattern
subtopics.strategy: Reverse entire list, partial list, or groups to reorder nodes.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions reversing nodes or rearranging linked list order.

subtopics.name: Merge / Sort
subtopics.strategy: Merge sorted lists, sort list using merge sort, or reorder using middle + reverse + merge.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions merging, sorting, or reordering linked lists.

subtopics.name: LinkedList with Stack / HashMap
subtopics.strategy: Use a stack to handle backward traversal, carry logic, or next greater node.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions reverse order processing or “next greater” style operations.

topics.name: Double Linked List
topics.description: Nodes with prev+next pointers — O(1) insert/remove at both ends.

subtopics.name: Basic DLL Operations
subtopics.strategy: Maintain prev and next pointers carefully for insert, delete, traversal; use DLL + HashMap for O(1) cache operations.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions insertion/deletion in DLL, printing forwards/backwards, or caching (LRU/MRU/frequency-based).

problems.title: LRU Cache — DLL + HashMap for O(1) cache

topics.name: HashMap
topics.description: O(1) average lookups — frequency counting, prefix maps and design.

subtopics.name: Frequency Map / Counting
subtopics.strategy: Count elements to find majority, top-k frequent, or sort by frequency.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions frequency, duplicates, top-k, or counting occurrences.

subtopics.name: Prefix-Sum with Map
subtopics.strategy: Track cumulative sums; map stores first occurrence → solve subarray sum problems.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves subarray sums, cumulative sums, or “sum equals K”.

subtopics.name: HashMap Design (implementation)
subtopics.strategy: Back the structure with a bucket array plus chaining, then implement hash, put, get, and remove on top of it.
subtopics.identification: Problem says “design” or “implement” a map/set without using the language’s built-in one.

topics.name: Stack
topics.description: LIFO structure — monotonic stacks, expression evaluation and design.

subtopics.name: Monotonic Stack
subtopics.strategy: Maintain a monotonic increasing/decreasing stack to find next/prev greater/smaller, histogram ranges, or collisions.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “next greater/smaller element,” spans, or trapping area.

subtopics.name: Expression Evaluation
subtopics.strategy: Use two stacks or postfix evaluation to handle numbers and operators efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem involves evaluating arithmetic expressions, parentheses, or decoding strings.

subtopics.name: Stack Simulation / Undo Operation
subtopics.strategy: Simulate operations using a stack → pop on undo, remove adjacent duplicates, collapse characters.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “undo,” “remove duplicates,” or “backspace string” operations.

subtopics.name: Parenthesis & Scoring
subtopics.strategy: Push opening symbols and validate closing ones; sometimes track count or score.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions parentheses, balanced brackets, scoring, or generation.

subtopics.name: Stack-Based Design
subtopics.strategy: Use two stacks to implement another data structure or maintain extra info.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions designing stack/queue systems or custom operations.

topics.name: Recursion
topics.description: Solving a problem in terms of smaller instances of itself.

subtopics.name: Linear Recursion
subtopics.strategy: Solve problems by reducing them to a simpler instance of the same problem.
subtopics.identification: Problems requiring repetitive smaller tasks without splitting into multiple branches.

topics.name: Tree
topics.description: Binary tree traversals and structural queries.

subtopics.name: DFS Traversals
subtopics.strategy: Standard DFS → used for max depth, path sums, subtree calculations.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “visit all nodes recursively, max depth/path/subtree sum.”

subtopics.name: BFS / Level-Order
subtopics.strategy: Use queue → traverse level by level → calculate sums, averages, or side views.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “level-order, breadth-first, zigzag, right-side view, or level sum/average.”

problems.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal

subtopics.name: Lowest Common Ancestor
subtopics.strategy: DFS recursion or parent-pointer mapping → find common ancestor efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “find common ancestor, distance between nodes, or lowest node covering two nodes.”

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree

topics.name: Binary Search Tree
topics.description: Ordered binary trees — search, insert, delete and validation.

subtopics.name: BST Operations
subtopics.strategy: Leverage BST property (left < root < right) for search, insertion, deletion, and range queries.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “BST operations, validate BST, insert/delete nodes, or sum/range queries.”

problems.title: Search in a Binary Search Tree
Insert into a Binary Search Tree

topics.name: Graph
topics.description: BFS/DFS, topological ordering and union-find over vertices & edges.

subtopics.name: BFS (Unweighted Path)
subtopics.strategy: Standard BFS → track distance/levels → queue-based traversal → multi-source if needed.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “shortest path, level-order traversal, or unweighted distance”.

subtopics.name: DFS (Connectivity)
subtopics.strategy: DFS recursion or stack → track visited → identify connected components or detect cycles.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “connected components, islands, cycles, safe states, bipartite check, bridges, articulation points, or connectivity check”.

subtopics.name: Topological Sort
subtopics.strategy: DFS postorder or BFS (Kahn’s algorithm) → order nodes respecting dependencies.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “ordering tasks, course prerequisites, dependency chains, build order, or cycle in directed graph”.

problems.title: Largest Color Value in a Directed Graph

subtopics.name: MST / Union-Find
subtopics.strategy: Use Kruskal’s / Prim’s algorithm or Union-Find → find MST, minimum cost connections, or detect cycles.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “minimum cost to connect all nodes, redundant connections, union-find required”.

problems.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points

topics.name: Heap
topics.description: Priority queues — top-K, k-way merge and running medians.

subtopics.name: Top-K Elements
subtopics.strategy: Use min-heap for top-k largest, max-heap for top-k smallest → maintain heap of size k.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions top k, kth largest/smallest, median, or maintaining running extremes.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array

subtopics.name: Merge K Sorted
subtopics.strategy: Use min-heap to merge multiple sorted arrays/lists efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions merging sorted arrays/lists or finding K smallest/largest pairs across arrays.

subtopics.name: Implementation of Heap
subtopics.strategy: Build the heap yourself with sift-up/sift-down over an array, or hold two heaps — max-heap for the lower half, min-heap for the upper — and rebalance after every insert.
subtopics.identification: Problem asks you to design a priority queue, or to keep a running median or order statistic over a stream.

topics.name: Backtracking
topics.description: Systematic search with pruning over the decision tree.

subtopics.name: Choice-Based Backtracking
subtopics.strategy: At each level pick an unused candidate, recurse, then undo the pick; prune as soon as the partial answer overshoots the target.
subtopics.identification: Problem asks for all permutations or combinations reaching a target, where order or reuse of elements matters.

subtopics.name: Constraint-Based Backtracking
subtopics.strategy: Recurse on the index with two branches — include the element or exclude it — and record the path at each leaf.
subtopics.identification: Problem asks to generate every subset or selection where each element is simply taken or skipped.

subtopics.name: Grid / Path Backtracking
subtopics.strategy: Move in grid recursively → explore all valid paths → backtrack after each move.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maze, grid, pathfinding, sudoku, word search in grid, Hamiltonian path, or max path gold.”

subtopics.name: Decision Tree / Sequence Generation
subtopics.strategy: Generate sequences or strings recursively by making a choice at each step.
subtopics.identification: Problems where you recursively build sequences, combinations of digits/letters, or expressions.

topics.name: Greedy
topics.description: Locally optimal choices — intervals, reachability and sorting.

subtopics.name: Intervals & Reach
subtopics.strategy: Sort intervals or extend reach as far as possible from current position → maximize tasks done / minimize steps.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maximum non-overlapping intervals, tasks, meetings, jump to end, minimum steps, or cover intervals”.

subtopics.name: Sorting / Local Choice
subtopics.strategy: Sort array or select elements → make locally optimal choice → achieve global optimum.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “maximize/minimize sum, select elements optimally, assign/distribute resources, or custom order”.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Overlapping subproblems solved once and reused.

subtopics.name: 1D / Linear DP
subtopics.strategy: Track optimal solution using a 1D array → sequences, sums, or counts.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “subarrays, sequences, max/min sum/product, or linear decisions”.

subtopics.name: 2D / Grid DP
subtopics.strategy: Use 2D array → track states for row/column → movement or path constraints.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “grids, movement from start to end, paths, or matrix-based sums”.

subtopics.name: DP on Strings
subtopics.strategy: Use 2D DP → index i,j represent substrings/subsequences → solve LCS, palindrome, or edit distance.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “subsequence, substring, longest common, palindrome, or string edit operations”.

subtopics.name: Knapsack / Subset Sum
subtopics.strategy: Track states based on weight/value → classic 0-1 / bounded / unbounded variants.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “choose subset under constraints, maximize value, target sum, or weight limit”.

subtopics.name: DP on Stocks
subtopics.strategy: State machine DP to track whether you are holding a stock or not.
subtopics.identification: Problems involving buying and selling stocks to maximize profit with varying constraints.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock

topics.name: Trie
topics.description: Prefix trees for string retrieval and segmentation.

subtopics.name: Basic Trie Operations
subtopics.strategy: Build Trie → insert words → search full word or prefix efficiently → collect suggestions in lexicographic order.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “dictionary, prefix search, word lookup, autocomplete, or predictive text”.

subtopics.name: Word Break / Segmentation
subtopics.strategy: Use Trie for fast lookup → combine with DP or backtracking for word segmentation and concatenation.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “word segmentation, dictionary words, concatenated words, or string break”.

topics.name: Bit Manipulation

subtopics.name: Basic Bit Operations
subtopics.strategy: Use XOR / AND / OR / shift operations → detect single/missing numbers or count bits efficiently.
subtopics.identification: Problem mentions “unique element, missing number, or bit counting”.
